reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Peter Reinhardt, co-founder and CEO of Segment.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Peter Reinhardt, co-founder and CEO of Segment, the market-leading data customer data platform that was acquired by Twilio last year. In our conversation, we cover the fascinating journey of Segment from an education feedback tool to the business it is today. This was an incredibly honest conversation on company building that any builder can learn a lot from.

key_points.text: In our conversation, we cover the fascinating journey of Segment from an education feedback tool to the business it is today.
